title: CYBRIK model inference request v1
description: Provider-neutral request from Cyber AI (or SOC) to the CYBRIK model-runtime seam (ADR-0002 G3). Tenant/actor/org fields are ADVISORY: the platform derives authoritative tenant/actor/org from the caller credential and rejects cross-tenant mismatch. The model receives NO credential, database, tool, or shell authority, and this request carries NONE — there is deliberately no capability, delegation_ref, approval_id, tool, mcp, or action-authorization field. The concrete vendor/model is never named: model_class is a policy-selected class resolved server-side. Idempotency key prevents replay; it is not authority. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED (v0.1.0).

request_id.description: Caller-assigned logical request id (e.g. 'inf_…'). Correlates request → result/error → audit/eval telemetry.

idempotency_key.description: Mandatory. Same key + same resolved request = same result, never a second billed/side-effecting inference. Not replay authority after the correlated authorization/deadline expires.

actor.description: Advisory actor; the platform derives authoritative actor/tenant from the credential. tenant_id required because cross-tenant authorization is evaluated here.

purpose.description: Declared processing purpose (purpose-limitation for data handling), e.g. 'alert_triage_summary'.

inputs.description: Template variables bound into the governed prompt_template. Validated server-side against the template's own input schema. Free-form; treated as UNTRUSTED content and subject to redaction_policy before reaching any runtime.

context_refs.description: Digest-bound references to product-owned objects (e.g. soc.alert, soc.case, soc.alert_snapshot) that supply grounding context. Referenced, not inlined, so the platform dereferences through the owner's authorized API under the caller's authority and applies marking/redaction. Client-asserted content is never trusted over the owner's copy.

requested_features.description: Optional requested inference features (subset of the resolved model class's capability.supported_features). A feature not advertised by the resolved class MUST fail closed (error_class 'unsupported_feature'); unknown features are never silently ignored.

response_mode.description: Transport shape of the response. 'complete' returns one aggregate result; 'stream' streams tokens with the SAME typed result as the final aggregate (streaming framing is adapter metadata, not a wire-schema change).

deadline_seconds.description: Caller deadline; the platform clamps to the resolved model class's own timeout and never above it.

sampling.description: Optional provider-neutral decoding controls. Bounded, vendor-agnostic; a runtime maps these to its native knobs in adapter metadata.

seed.description: Optional determinism seed; honored only if the resolved class advertises the 'seeded' feature.
